mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.from_user_id, r.to_user_id, p.id AS peer_id, p.nickname AS peer_nickname, p.handle AS peer_handle, r.note, r.status, r.created_at FROM im_friend_request r JOIN im_user p ON p.id = CASE WHEN r.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN r.to_user_id ELSE r.from_user_id END WHERE r.from_user_id = #{userId} OR r.to_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT id, from_user_id, to_user_id, status FROM im_friend_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_friendship WHERE user_low_id = #{low} AND user_high_id = #{high}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_friend_request (from_user_id, to_user_id, note) VALUES (#{fromId}, #{toId}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE im_friend_request SET status = #{state}, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO im_friendship (user_low_id, user_high_id) VALUES (#{low}, #{high})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM im_friendship WHERE user_low_id = #{low} AND user_high_id = #{high}
